create_videoseal_model: create a Videoseal model with embedder, detector, augmenter, and optional JND attenuation for video watermarking
embed_watermark_video: embed a binary message as a watermark into a video tensor using the Videoseal embed method
detect_watermark_video: detect and extract watermark predictions from an augmented watermarked video tensor
extract_message_video: extract and aggregate a decoded binary message from a watermarked video across frames
apply_video_mode: apply repeat, alternate, or interpolate video mode to expand watermark predictions across frames
